data.name: Holiday Inn Express Puebla
data.address: Blvd. Hermanos Serdan : 45, Amor, 72140 Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza, Pue., Mexico
data.description:
This modern hotel is 3 km from Puebla Cathedral, 13 km from Estadio Cuauhtémoc soccer stadium and 12 km from the Cholula archaeological site.
Understated rooms offer free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, as well as desks, minibars and coffeemakers. Suites add kitchenettes, and living areas with pull-out sofas. There's 24-hour room service.
Complimentary perks include a breakfast buffet and parking. There's also an indoor pool and a gym.
